title: Move the unsafe-code ratchet out of core
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO decision 2026-11-18 (Tier 2, option A): the unsafe-code ratchet leaves core for Susi Commercial Apps (T-CLAUDERATCHET-1). Core's release coordinator builds unsafe_measure and unsafe_ratchet from the newest released v* tag of a Susi Commercial Apps checkout that contains the crate (--tools-repo, SUSI_COMMERCIAL_CHECKOUT or the sibling clone), keeping held, digest-pinned, read-only tools and the same gate checks. Core keeps its reviewed baselines and the build-time UCRT crate (core cannot build without it). Delete the crate, move the test of core's CI scripts into core's tests, forward the owed-receipts script, correct the contract and documents, and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-unsafe-ratchet, release coordinator and gate, CI scripts and contract; Susi Commercial Apps' release tags. Delete and redirect: no new dependency.
